preamble:
-- core Lean only, no Mathlib

class Grp (G : Type) extends Mul G, One G, Inv G where
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : G, a * b * c = a * (b * c)
  one_mul : ∀ a : G, 1 * a = a
  mul_one : ∀ a : G, a * 1 = a
  inv_mul : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ * a = 1
  mul_inv : ∀ a : G, a * a⁻¹ = 1

open Grp

def gaugeTransform {G X : Type} [Grp G] (g : X → G) (U : X → X → G) : X → X → G :=
  fun x y => g x * U x y * (g y)⁻¹

def holonomy4 {G X : Type} [Grp G] (U : X → X → G) (a b c d : X) : G :=
  U a b * U b c * U c d * U d a

targets.name: nat_add_comm_t
targets.statement: theorem nat_add_comm_t (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a

targets.name: lattice_sites_even
targets.about: a 2L-site periodic chain has an even number of sites

targets.name: list_rev_rev_t
targets.statement: theorem list_rev_rev_t (l : List Nat) : l.reverse.reverse = l

targets.name: gauge_link_cancel
targets.about: interior gauge factors cancel on two consecutive links
targets.statement: theorem gauge_link_cancel {G X : Type} [Grp G] (g : X → G) (U : X → X → G) (a b c : X) : gaugeTransform g U a b * gaugeTransform g U b c = g a * (U a b * U b c) * (g c)⁻¹
